pose: Strict wall-supported HANDSTAND PUSH-UP bottom. Athlete upside down with back toward plain dark wall, heels lightly contacting wall, straight legs together vertically upward, hips stacked above shoulders. Both palms floor shoulder-width about25cm from wall, elbows flexed90deg, crown few centimeters above floor ahead of hand line. No head resting weight on floor. Side three-quarter shows wall, two hands and full legs/shoes. Shirt stays naturally at torso, gaze floor between hands, neck neutral.

grip: one elbow bent; opposite arm long
pose: ARCHER RING ROW contracted one side: body rigid inclined back with heels on floor, chest pulled toward LEFT ring with left elbow flexed, RIGHT arm straight out laterally holding right ring far from chest. BOTH straps taut toward distinct overhead anchors on real grounded rack crossbar. Chest square to ring anchors, torso not twisted, head aligned looking toward anchors. Rear-delt-biased wide elbow plane. Wide front three-quarter shows asymmetry of arms and hands. No weights.

NEUTRAL GRIP pull-up near top, two black cylindrical handles project FORE-AFT from one supported rack crossmember about shoulder width apart. Palms face each other, thumb wrapped over grips, elbows flex down beside ribs, chin at handle level, torso vertical legs hanging mild knee bend. Camera front-three-quarter clearly shows two parallel grips oriented perpendicular to crossmember and solid welded gussets/bolted rack anchors. Full athlete and stable rack base. No weights/bands.

WIDE GRIP strict pull-up mid-top with palms facing away and hands clearly about1.5 shoulder widths apart on ONE straight 30mm bar mounted to two realistic rack posts 120cm apart. Elbows out and down about90deg. Upright torso feet suspended no kipping. Straight frontal camera slightly offset shows width, symmetry, bar and both mounted ends. Neck aligned spine, face forward rather than camera glance, no added loads.

CHIN-UP at top. Palms face TOWARD ATHLETE with unmistakable UNDERHAND grip shoulder-width, inner forearms and curled fingers visible toward face. Both elbows flexed down close to torso, chin clears bar, neutral neck. One straight bar 30mm diameter fixed at both ends to rack posts with mountingbolts, real proportions stable base. Front-three-quarter view shows supinated grip, entire suspended body and rack feet, no weight/band.

STERNUM CHIN-UP in characteristic high contracted phase: underhand supinated grip medium width, lean entire straight torso BACK roughly35 degrees, lift lower chest/sternum toward straight fixed bar, elbows pulled down/back. Legs extend diagonally slightly ahead to counterbalance, no enormous lumbar bend. Head follows upper spine/torso, gaze up along chest direction. Side-three-quarter camera shows difference from vertical ordinary chinup. Stable real rack with mounted bar and grounded bases, all extremities.

SCAPULAR PULL-UP at active depressed shoulder phase, ELBOWS FULLY STRAIGHT, overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, body raised a few centimeters by shoulders away from ears only. Full body hangs vertical, ribs down, feet together off floor. Rear three-quarter camera sees shoulder blades drawn down, back of head aligned forward with torso, NO face turn. Real single straight bar mounted at both ends rack height240cm, stable feetground.

INVERTED ROW contracted top: a fixed straight30mm bar at90cm height solidly mounted between rack posts. Athlete below bar face up, rigid shoulders-hips-knees-heels diagonal line, both heels on floor and toes upward, chest almost touches bar, elbows flexed back, overhand shoulder width hands. Low side three-quarter shows both bar attachments and athlete with adequate headroom, legs straight, neck aligned torso looking up, no floor-pushup pose.
